I am a 64-year-old woman in Kilimanjaro with some schooling, and I have farmed this land since I was young. This plot is only 0.06 hectares — very small, not even one-tenth of a hectare — so buying a full bag of chemical fertilizer makes no sense because it is too much money and too much fertilizer for this tiny piece. I will put manure on it because I own the land and I want to keep the soil soft and fertile, and I will plant seed I saved from last season since it still grows well. My family and I will work this plot with hoes for about 16 days over the season, and I will not hire anyone or spend money on sprays and irrigation for such a small home plot.
